responsibility: This file is the central driver and utility layer for lowering resolved Fortran code to GCC GENERIC. It provides shared block-building and temporary-creation helpers, source-location conversion, likely/unlikely annotation wrappers, and init/cleanup wrapping support, and it dispatches each gfc_code opcode to the appropriate statement translator while orchestrating whole-program-unit generation for procedures, modules, and BLOCK DATA units. In effect, it is the glue that sequences namespace-level code generation and assembles the statement trees produced by the specialized trans-* files.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the central translation driver and common utility implementation: block/temporary helpers, location handling, branch-prediction wrappers, wrapped-block support, statement dispatch, and whole-program-unit/module code generation. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans.h, it is the coordinating implementation glue rather than the foundational shared data-structure and macro header for the translation subsystem.
